'''Ravelin''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. It contained [[Disra's palace]], the [[Imperial records library|Imperial Library]], and the [[Moff Assembly Hall]].
